description: The House of Wax (Lakshagriha). A mansion built by Duryodhana's architect Purochana, secretly constructed with flammable lac. The Pandavas' first assassination attempt. VN-only backdrop for the Adi Parva escape scene.

vn_backdrop_notes.lighting: Warm interior firelight transitioning to panic as flames spread.
vn_backdrop_notes.mood: Claustrophobic, ominous. The walls are slick with resin.
interactive_elements: Secret tunnel entrance that Vidura warned about
